# Oxigraph 0.5.8 SELECT wire captures

These four files were captured directly from the repository-pinned
`oxigraph_v0.5.8_aarch64_apple` binary, whose download is checksum-verified by
`packages/cli/src/daemon/oxigraph-binary.ts`. They are paired TSV/JSON responses
for the same queries, not output generated by the test helper.

The mixed fixture selects `?s ?plain ?lang ?typed ?iri` from a graph containing
a blank-node row with an escaped newline literal, language literal, typed
literal and IRI, plus a named-node row whose optional language and typed cells
are unbound. The empty fixture is the exact response to:

```sparql
SELECT ?v WHERE { FILTER(false) }
```

The empty TSV payload is exactly three bytes: `?v\n`.
